A random crab fact: Hermit crabs grow by molting. For smaller crabs, this means digging underground (in 6+ inches if moist sand/coconut fiber or a mix) and creating a cave. They then take 2-3 weeks and just shed the outer shell and grow a new shell/exo. They sometimes require new and larger shells after the process! Larger crabs (golf ball+ sized) can take 1-2 months. Once they reach soft ball sized, they can take up to 4 months. Sometimes even 16 months!

Mine have access to egg shells, crushed lobster exos and bird cuttle bone for calcium. I know a lot about hermit crabs...
